raw:
Ten matched blocks of 10 experiments each. In every block, the same edit is applied to 5 parents that meet a condition and to 5 near-identical parents that don't. Only the conditioning edge differs between the two halves, so any difference isolates the interaction.

| Block | Edit | Condition contrasted | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | e4 → conv3x3 | e5 = none vs. not | e4 becomes the only conv path into output |
| B | e2 → conv3x3 | e0 = none vs. not | node 1 dead → e2 is useless |
| C | e3 → none | e5 = none vs. not | removing a direct path when output inputs are scarce |
| D | e5 → avg_pool | e5 was conv3x3 vs. other | cost of replacing a conv |
| E | e3 → skip | e4 = conv3x3 vs. none | residual helps deep cells |
| F | e0 → conv3x3 | e0 was none vs. skip | reviving node 1 vs. upgrading |
| G | e1 → conv3x3 | e2 = none vs. not | node 2's sole input |
| H | e4 → skip | e3 = none vs. skip | redundant residual |
| I | e1 → none | e2 = none vs. not | disconnecting node 2 entirely |
| J | e3 → conv3x3 | e3 was skip vs. none | losing the residual vs. adding a path |
